content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where financial isolation and platform restrictions are a harsh reality, digital creators face significant barriers to selling their products online. With Stripe and PayPal unavailable, creators are left seeking alternative solutions to host and sell their digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and software. This is where COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure comes in, offering a way to build a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-keeps-failing-2|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-first-principles-4|Cloudflare R2]]-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-what-actually-11|cloudflare]] Pages without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to COREMERCH's infrastructure is its use of free and open-source tools, such as GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, which provide a scalable and secure foundation for digital stores. By leveraging these tools, creators can host their stores without relying on restrictive platforms, ensuring they maintain full ownership and control over their data and sales. This approach also enables seamless integration with crypto payment processors like NOWPayments, allowing for automatic on-chain payment verification and instant product delivery.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, you'll need to gather a few essential components. First, you'll need a domain name and a Cloudflare account to set up your store's hosting and SSL encryption. You'll also need to create a NOWPayments account to enable crypto payments and integrate it with your store. Additionally, you'll need to prepare your digital products, such as ebooks, courses, or software, and have them ready for upload to your store. With these components in place, you can begin the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages store. This involves generating an API key, configuring your payment settings, and testing your payment flow to ensure everything is working smoothly. You'll also need to set up your digital product delivery system, which can be done using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. By automating your payment and delivery pipeline, you can focus on creating and selling your digital products, rather than worrying about the technical details.
Build a scalable and secure crypto store without relying on restrictive platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've completed the deployment process, you can go live with your crypto store and start processing transactions. This involves configuring your store's settings, uploading your digital products, and testing your payment flow to ensure everything is working as expected. With your store live, you can begin promoting your products and accepting crypto payments from customers around the world. As you process your first transaction, you'll see the power of COREMERCH's infrastructure in action, with automatic payment verification and instant product delivery.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your crypto store grows and scales, you'll need to ensure your infrastructure can keep up with demand. This involves monitoring your store's performance, optimizing your payment and delivery pipeline, and scaling your hosting and storage as needed. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can easily scale your store to meet growing demand, without worrying about restrictive platforms or technical limitations. By leveraging the power of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, you can build a scalable and secure crypto store that meets the needs of your customers and drives your business forward.

To deploy your crypto store, start by setting up your Cloudflare account and domain name, then create a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your store. Next, prepare your digital products and upload them to your store, and configure your payment and delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. Finally, test your payment flow, go live with your store, and start processing transactions. With these steps, you can build a scalable and secure crypto store that accepts payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies.
